title: Insufficient Color Contrast on Discount Strikethrough Pricing
steps_to_reproduce: Inspect any product card showing original MRP strikethrough price
evidence: Lighthouse accessibility violation; measured contrast ratio 3.86:1 (foreground #8C7B63 on background #FBF8F2) at 10px-12px font size. Required minimum is 4.5:1.
impact: Low-vision users and users in bright daylight cannot read original reference pricing
recommended_fix: Deepen taupe-500 token from #8C7B63 to #6B5C49 (contrast 5.8:1) or use text-slate (#5B6676; contrast 5.49:1)

title: Floating WhatsApp CTA White Text Fails Contrast Against Light Green
steps_to_reproduce: Inspect floating WhatsApp action pill at bottom-right corner of viewport
evidence: Lighthouse contrast failure; white text (#FFFFFF) on brand green (#25D366) yields 1.98:1 contrast ratio, failing 4.5:1 minimum significantly.
impact: White CTA text is illegible for users with low contrast vision across all public pages
recommended_fix: Use deep ink text (#0A1F3A; contrast 9.6:1) or high-contrast deep green container (#128C7E; contrast 4.6:1)

title: Active Size Button Inventory Subtitle Fails Contrast Against Navy
steps_to_reproduce: On product detail page, select any active size option button (e.g. Size 28)
evidence: Active button background switches to bg-navy-800 (#0E2747), but subtitle 'In stock' remains text-slate (#5B6676), giving 2.58:1 contrast ratio.
impact: Inventory status becomes illegible when size pill is selected
recommended_fix: Condition subtitle text color on active state: use text-sand-300 (#DCCDB4; contrast 9.6:1) when selected

title: Accessible Name Mismatch on Add to Bag Action Buttons
steps_to_reproduce: Speech-to-text user issues command 'Click Add to Bag'
evidence: Lighthouse label-content-name-mismatch; visible label is 'Add to Bag' while accessible name is 'Add <Product Name> to bag'. Visible text is not leading substring.
impact: Speech recognition users cannot activate buttons via visible text commands
recommended_fix: Align accessible name to begin with visible label: aria-label="Add to Bag - <Product Name>"

title: Missing Landmark <main> on Standalone Admin Login Page
steps_to_reproduce: Run screen reader landmark navigation on /admin/login
evidence: Lighthouse landmark-one-main; page body contains divs but lacks a semantic <main> landmark.
impact: Screen reader users cannot jump directly to the login portal form using landmark shortcuts
recommended_fix: Wrap admin login card container in semantic <main className="min-h-screen ...">

title: Missing Form Labels on Admin Products Checkboxes and Filter Selects
steps_to_reproduce: Inspect select all checkbox, row checkboxes, and 6 catalog filter selects in admin table
evidence: Lighthouse flags 'label' and 'select-name'; elements lack implicit/explicit <label> or aria-label attributes.
impact: Screen reader announces 'checkbox unchecked' and 'select collapsed' without stating purpose or row item
recommended_fix: Add aria-label="Select all products" and aria-label="Select product {product.name}" and aria-label="Filter by School"

title: Form Validation Errors Lack ARIA Programmatic Association
steps_to_reproduce: Submit checkout form with empty mandatory fields; inline red error text appears beneath fields
evidence: Inputs lack aria-invalid='true', lack programmatic id, and error containers lack id for aria-describedby.
impact: Screen reader users focused on invalid field are not notified of validation failure or error requirements
recommended_fix: Add id="field-{name}" with aria-invalid={!!errors[name]} and aria-describedby={errors[name] ? "{name}-error" : undefined}

title: Heading Outline Hierarchy Skips from H1 Directly to H3
steps_to_reproduce: Inspect heading outline on catalog and product detail pages
evidence: Lighthouse heading-order violation; /shop jumps from H1 to H3 'Filter Catalog'; /product jumps from H1 to H3 'Tailoring Specifications'.
impact: Assistive technology users navigating via H key receive disorganized document outline
recommended_fix: Replace skipped H3 elements with semantic H2 elements styled with matching typography classes

title: Missing Skip-to-Content Link for Keyboard Navigation
steps_to_reproduce: Press Tab key on cold load of storefront page
evidence: Keyboard focus begins at announcement bar and traverses 10+ nav links before reaching main content; no skip link present.
impact: Keyboard-only and switch-device users must tab through entire header on every page transition
recommended_fix: Add skip link as first focusable child in PublicLayout: Skip to content

title: Mobile Drawer Missing Focus Trap and Escape Key Dismissal
steps_to_reproduce: Open mobile menu at 390px viewport; press Escape key
evidence: Menu remains open on Escape press; focus is not trapped within open drawer; background content remains interactive.
impact: Keyboard and switch navigation users cannot dismiss mobile drawer without scrolling back to trigger
recommended_fix: Add useEffect Escape keydown listener and focus trap in mobile navigation container

title: Mobile Menu Toggle Button Missing aria-expanded Attribute
steps_to_reproduce: Inspect mobile hamburger button in mobile viewport DOM
evidence: Button renders <Menu> or <X> icon but lacks aria-expanded attribute; accessibility tree reports button without expanded state.
impact: Screen reader users cannot determine whether navigation menu is currently open or collapsed
recommended_fix: Add aria-expanded={mobileMenuOpen} to mobile menu button

title: Undersized Touch Targets on Mobile Viewports (< 44x44px)
selector: button[aria-label='Toggle menu'] (40x40), button[aria-label^='Cart'] (42x42), size pills (22px high)
steps_to_reproduce: Measure bounding client rect on 320px/360px viewport emulation
evidence: DevTools inspect reveals hamburger button is 40x40px, cart trigger is 42x42px, and size pills are 22px high.
impact: High touch miss rate on physical smartphone screens; thumb presses trigger unintended adjacent elements
recommended_fix: Enforce min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px] touch target wrapper or padding on all mobile interactive elements

title: Header Action Cluster Overflows Right Margin at 200% Font Zoom
steps_to_reproduce: Zoom text to 200% on 1280px desktop screen
evidence: Computed scrollWidth: 1272px vs clientWidth: 1272px; search input right edge collides with cart icon container before mobile collapse breakpoint.
impact: Magnified text users experience clipped controls before header switches to mobile drawer
recommended_fix: Collapse desktop navigation to drawer at lg breakpoint instead of md when text is scaled

title: Render-Blocking Google Fonts CSS Link Delays Initial Render
steps_to_reproduce: Record cold performance trace in DevTools Performance panel
evidence: Performance Insights flags RenderBlocking on fonts.googleapis.com/css2; estimated savings 308ms FCP and 308ms LCP.
impact: Delays browser First Contentful Paint while remote font stylesheet is requested and parsed
recommended_fix: Preload critical fonts or self-host via @fontsource packages with modern font-display swap

title: Oversized Cloudinary Images in Grid Display Cards
steps_to_reproduce: Inspect ImageDelivery insight in Chrome DevTools Performance trace
evidence: Product cards request w_800 (800x1200px) images from Cloudinary but display at 267x400px; DevTools reports ~64 kB wasted bytes per image (~500 kB total).
impact: Increases cellular data consumption and delays Largest Contentful Paint on mobile networks
recommended_fix: Implement responsive srcset (w_300 300w

title: Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS) on Asynchronous Product Rendering
steps_to_reproduce: Run cold navigation Lighthouse audit on /shop and /product/:slug
evidence: Measured CLS: 0.318 on /shop and 0.316 on /product/:slug; exceeds Google Core Web Vitals 'Good' threshold of 0.10.
impact: Visual layout jumps when async React Query data resolves and replaces loading skeletons
recommended_fix: Enforce exact aspect-[3/4] container aspect ratio and fixed min-height on product cards and skeletons

title: Missing Canonical <link rel="canonical"> Tags Across Storefront
steps_to_reproduce: Inspect document.head across /, /shop, /product/:slug, /school/:slug
evidence: document.querySelector('link[rel=canonical]') returns null across all pages.
impact: Risk of search ranking cannibalization across URL filter query parameters (?category=...) and route aliases
recommended_fix: Add <link rel="canonical" href={canonicalUrl} /> via react-helmet-async in SEO component

title: Relative og:image Path Breaks Previews on External Social Scrapers
steps_to_reproduce: Inspect Open Graph meta tags on Home and Product pages
evidence: og:image content is '/og-image.png' (relative path); Open Graph protocol requires fully-qualified absolute URL (https://.../og-image.png).
impact: Shared links on WhatsApp and social media display broken or missing image preview cards
recommended_fix: Prepend window.location.origin or production SITE_URL in SEO component og:image tag

title: Missing Schema.org Product & Offer Structured Data on Product Detail
steps_to_reproduce: Inspect JSON-LD structured data on /product/dps-bhopal-blazer
evidence: jsonLd script tags return empty array []; only homepage contains ClothingStore schema.
impact: Google search engine cannot display rich snippets (price INR 1650
recommended_fix: in-stock badge
wcag: Inject Schema.org Product and Offer JSON-LD schema on all individual product detail pages

title: Missing noindex nofollow Robots Tag on Checkout Page
steps_to_reproduce: Inspect robots meta tags on /checkout
evidence: document.querySelector('meta[name=robots]') returns null on /checkout.
impact: Search engines could crawl and index empty checkout URLs or private session parameters
recommended_fix: Add <meta name="robots" content="noindex

title: Missing Disallow for /checkout and /cart in robots.txt
steps_to_reproduce: Inspect public/robots.txt file
evidence: robots.txt disallows /admin and /api/, but leaves /checkout and /cart open to crawling.
impact: Crawlers may waste crawl budget requesting ephemeral user carts and session checkout URLs
recommended_fix: Add 'Disallow: /checkout' and 'Disallow: /cart' to public/robots.txt

title: Document Title Not Updated to Checkout on Guest Checkout Route
steps_to_reproduce: Add item to bag on /product/dps-bhopal-blazer and click Checkout
evidence: document.title remains 'Dps Bhopal Blazer | Indraprasth Uniforms Bhopal' on /checkout route.
impact: Disorienting browser tab label for users with multiple open tabs
recommended_fix: Add <SEO title="Checkout | Indraprasth Uniforms Bhopal" /> in Checkout.tsx

title: Missing React Root and Route-Level Error Boundaries
steps_to_reproduce: Search codebase for ErrorBoundary or componentDidCatch implementations
evidence: No custom React ErrorBoundary exists in client codebase; unhandled component errors unmount entire app to blank screen.
impact: Component render exception causes whole app to crash instead of rendering recoverable error card
recommended_fix: Wrap routes in a high-grade ErrorBoundary component with reload and home recovery buttons

title: Missing @media print Stylesheet for Order Invoices and Slips
steps_to_reproduce: Trigger print dialog (Ctrl+P) on Admin Order Detail view
evidence: Print preview renders dark admin sidebar navigation, action buttons, and background gradients.
impact: Wastes client printer ink and prints unnecessary UI navigation headers on physical packing slips
recommended_fix: Add print:hidden to admin sidebar and header; define clean black-and-white @media print invoice styling
